issue.title: Drop #prj and #hide from picker and Task Card display text
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Picker rows and Task Card display text should drop machine-managed `#prj` (the identity partner immediately after `#task`, any case) and exact `#hide` the same way they already drop `#ref`.

`taskWikilinkSearchText` in `plugins/block-id-prompt/src/031-task-wikilink-rules.js` (copied in `bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/256-task-split-plan.js`) skips `#task` plus a following `#ref`. Extend that drop so `#task #prj Ship it #hide ^prj` displays as `Ship it`, matching `📖 Harness Engineering` for `#task #ref`. `#prj_is_blocked` and `#hidden` stay. Vault text is unchanged.

Conformance lives beside `scripts/test-block-id-prompt-ref-picker-text.cjs`. Contract: `docs/task-tag-marks.md` currently lists this as a non-goal deferred from plan:202611/prj_hide_tag_marks.md.

## Why out of scope

ACE decision `pickers=defer` on plan:202611/prj_hide_tag_marks.md limited that implementation to Live Preview, Reading view, and Tasks-row CSS marks. Picker and Task Card display-text parity was explicitly deferred.

task_type_fields.proposal: Drop `#prj` (identity partner after `#task`) and exact `#hide` from picker and Task Card display text, matching the existing `#ref` drop in `taskWikilinkSearchText`.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: ACE decision pickers=defer on plan:202611/prj_hide_tag_marks.md limited this turn to Live Preview, Reading view, and Tasks-row CSS marks.

issue.creation_reason: ACE pickers=defer on the just-implemented prj/hide task-tag-marks plan; file the deferred picker and Task Card display-text parity so it is not lost.
